jobs.title: Porquinho separado
jobs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent standalone piggy-bank character sprite for the Magic Mail mobile game's HUD.
Input image is the edit target. Extract ONLY this exact red glossy piggy-bank character from its backing container. Remove the entire emerald green disk and all purple/gold badge rims behind it. Fill in any small pig silhouette areas previously hidden by the backing as needed. Preserve the character's exact identity and appearance: chunky big angular head and spiky forelock on the left foreground, plump protruding round red ceramic body on the right, short little feet, curly tail, salmon-pink muzzle and ears, dark expressive brows, green eyes and cheeky smile, single EMPTY dark slot on top of its back. No coin, no container, no medallion, no border, no costume, no extra accessories. Keep the same three-quarter pose and Christmas red color, broad glossy highlights, deep red shadows and polished casual-game cartoon finish. A single entire isolated character, centered on a square canvas with 7 percent breathing room all around, nothing cropped. All background outside the pig is truly transparent, no checkerboard, no background scene, no lettering or watermark. This must be a reusable FOREGROUND sprite that can be layered over different blue containers.

jobs.title: 01 · Medalhão azul
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one separate BACKGROUND CONTAINER sprite for a piggy-bank event shortcut in Magic Mail, a glossy purple/gold postal fantasy mobile game. Create the empty backing alone; a separate big-headed red pig will overlap its front, top, left and right edges. The center must be filled blue enamel, NOT a transparent hole. Polished chunky simple casual-game cartoon material with broad creamy-white specular highlights, sculpted rounded bevel, deep cobalt/navy edge shadows, and restrained rich purple plus warm gold trim matching the game HUD. Rich cyan/royal blue interior, cheerful luminous blue that contrasts red Christmas pig. Readable at 80px, clean bold silhouette, very simple details, no busy filigree. Centered front-facing complete isolated asset occupying about 83 percent of square canvas; small integrated lower drop shadow, truly transparent outside, modest margins, no text, no watermark, no pig, no person, no coins, no dollar symbols, no numbers, no extra objects. Shape variation: simple ROUND DOMED MEDALLION with thick cobalt lower lip, luminous blue gently raised face and one slim purple-and-gold outer trim. Cleanest and closest to a classic mobile-game piggy-bank backing. No ribbons or additional decorations.
